latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – provides educational support for common sports injuries.

- Offers information on typical sports injuries based on user’s activity and symptoms.
- Includes a symptom severity assessment guide to help determine when to seek professional care.
- Suggests basic self-care options for minor, self-limiting conditions only.
- Clearly outlines red flags requiring immediate medical attention.
- Provides conservative, educational return-to-activity guidelines.
- Covers the distinctions between acute and overuse injuries, as well as sprains vs. strains, along with general prevention tips.
